title: Introduction of the new graphic identity

location.extent: Published poster for complete introduction film

slide_intent: Explain a flexible identity through change because a static mark cannot by itself show the behavior that makes it a system.
strategic_value: The unfolding and reforming line can make Whitney’s responsiveness to art understandable within a short introduction.
demonstration: The film builds a W from a line, multiplies it, adapts it around artworks, and ends with the May 2013 identity announcement and credits.
practical_value: Observe how the shape responds to artwork placement; do not derive timing or easing requirements from this introductory film.

content_islands.name: Opening construction
content_islands.spec: Begin with a horizontal line and develop the four-segment W and Whitney word.

content_islands.name: Responsive examples
content_islands.spec: Sequence artworks and changing W shapes across the white field.

content_islands.name: Closing information
content_islands.spec: Finish with the introduction title, date and artwork/music credits.

reference_purposes.Expression: The complete film shows the line unfolding, repeating and reforming around different artworks.
reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent essay frames the identity as a platform for future designers’ authorship rather than an automatic template.
